messages:
casey-support: FYI received a subpoena from Cascade Health asking for access to request logs + message payloads for a single patient ID for Sep 2025. They want raw logs and key metadata. They copied the legal contact. Asking what we can provide under the BAA.

sam-legal: Thanks Casey. We need the signed subpoena and narrow scope (patient ID, time range). Confirm whether the request is for PII or PHI in payloads — that changes process. Do not export anything until legal confirms.

casey-support: Customer claims it's PHI (lab results attached). They have the subpoena PDF attached to the support ticket. They also tried our admin portal export and got a 403. Quote from ticket: "export job failed: kms:AccessDenied: caller not authorized to use key alias/rdw-prod-hsm"

alex-ops: That 403 makes sense if the customer's KMS key is customer-managed and has strict key usage policy. Which export path did they use? admin UI or API?

casey-support: They used admin UI first, then tried API: `POST /v1/admin/logs/export` with payload: `{ "range": "2025-09-01..2025-09-30", "format": "ndjson", "key_alias": "alias/rdw-prod-hsm" }` and got the kms error.

priya-eng: Quick checklist: 1) confirm whether we store full message payloads for that org (some customers opt out) 2) check retention window for logs 3) KMS key ownership (customer vs. Redwood-managed) 4) whether HSM-backed export is allowed for on-prem/private customers.

mike-sre: I pulled the org config: private deployment in eu-west-1, logs retained 18 months, full payloads enabled. Key alias shows as `alias/cascade-hsm` and is an HSM-wrapped CMK with policy: `AllowDecrypt` only for a limited principal set (no service account for exports). That explains AccessDenied.

casey-support: Customer is asking for an explanation and timeline. They want the export within 48 hours.

sam-legal: We need to reply with: 1) we received subpoena and are evaluating 2) we will comply subject to legal review and any protections (redaction/partial export) 3) we need customer to authorize key unwrap if they manage keys or provide a court order if they want us to force export. Ask them to confirm the exact fields they need.

alex-ops: For technical path: if key is customer-managed HSM, only the customer or their KMS principal can decrypt key material. Options: - Customer can run an export themselves from their admin console (we can provide command) - If customer authorizes us, they must add our export service principal to the CMK policy OR provide a signed key escrow request via the HSM vendor support process.

priya-eng: Commands we can share (customer-run): ```
# example, run from private deployment admin
redwood logs export --org cascade-health --start 2025-09-01 --end 2025-09-30 --format ndjson --output s3://cascade-exports/subpoena/ --kms-alias alias/cascade-hsm
```
If that still errors they need to check KMS key policy.

mike-sre: If customer cannot change key policy, we can offer a redacted audit package (no raw PHI): aggregated timeline, redacted message IDs, and audit trail showing accesses. That we can produce without decrypting payloads.

casey-support: Customer replied saying they cannot change KMS policy without legal sign-off and they prefer Redwood to export. They also asked whether HSM export is possible under our BAA.

sam-legal: Under the BAA we can assist in compliance activities but we cannot unilaterally bypass customer-managed key controls. We need either (A) customer grants export principal OR (B) signed court order authorizing third-party access to keys/contents. We should offer the redacted package in the meantime.

alex-ops: Actionable next steps I can take now: 1) prepare redacted export (no PHI) and deliver within 24 hours 2) draft instructions for customer to add `arn:redwood:iam::export-service` to CMK `Decrypt` policy 3) if they supply signed court order, we can coordinate a special export with infra on-call to request HSM vendor assistance.

casey-support: I'll tell them that. Can you also capture exact error logs we saw? They may need them for their legal team.

audit-bot: log snippet for export job `job_9f3a`: `{ "ts": "2025-10-08T16:12:34Z", "org": "cascade-health", "job": "export", "status": "failed", "error": "kms:AccessDenied: Caller not authorized for alias/cascade-hsm" }`

infra-bot: KMS policy dump (sanitized) for alias/cascade-hsm: "\"Statement\": [{\"Effect\":\"Deny\",\"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"*\"},\"Action\":\"kms:Decrypt\",\"Resource\":\"*\",\"Condition\":{\"StringNotEquals\":{\"kms:CallerAccount\":\"123456789012\"}}}]"

priya-eng: If legal approves, we can run a controlled export flow where we: 1) generate a minimal extraction script 2) run it in an isolated job 3) have two infra engineers co-sign and attest 4) provide a hash-signed package and audit log to customer and legal. That preserves chain-of-custody.

sam-legal: Good. Draft a standard response (I'll review) and request the subpoena + signed authorization for key policy change or court order. Also ask them to confirm the exact patient identifiers and time window.

casey-support: I'll send response now. Thanks all. Will follow up when customer replies. :thumbsup:
